dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "A wealthy-looking girl dressed in purple came by here a few days ago, asking all sorts of things about the land, people's daily consumption, and such. She seemed to be from the city."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When I asked who she was, she said she was a general secretary from Yujing Terrace, sure enough. City folk really are thorough at their job..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You seldom see such vigorous, resolute demeanor in young people these days."
